name: Create a custom detection location for a zone.
description: Create a custom detection location for a zone. Create a detection location for credentials that the default scan locations do not cover, using Rules language expressions such as `lookup_json_string(http.request.body.raw, "user")`. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections
Create a detection location for credentials that the default scan locations do not cover, using Rules language expressions such as `lookup_json_string(http.request.body.raw, "user")`. Only the username expression is required, and Leaked Credential Checks must be enabled on the zone.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a custom detection location from a zone.
description: Delete a custom detection location from a zone. Delete a user-defined detection location, identified by its detection ID. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections/{detection_id}

name: Get a custom detection location of a zone.
description: Get a custom detection location of a zone. Get the username and password expressions of a single user-defined detection location, identified by its detection ID. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections/{detection_id}

name: Get the Leaked Credential Checks status for a zone.
description: Get the Leaked Credential Checks status for a zone. Get the current Leaked Credential Checks status for the zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks
Get the current Leaked Credential Checks status for the zone. While enabled, Cloudflare scans incoming requests for usernames and passwords that were exposed in known data breaches.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: List the custom detection locations of a zone.
description: List the custom detection locations of a zone. List the user-defined detection locations configured for Leaked Credential Checks, each with its own identifier. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections
List the user-defined detection locations configured for Leaked Credential Checks, each with its own identifier. A custom detection location tells the WAF where to find the username and password in requests to your application.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Update the Leaked Credential Checks status for a zone.
description: Update the Leaked Credential Checks status for a zone. Update the Leaked Credential Checks status for the zone, enabling or disabling the detection. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks
Update the Leaked Credential Checks status for the zone, enabling or disabling the detection. While enabled, the detection populates the `cf.waf.credential_check.*` fields, which you can reference in custom rules and rate limiting rules to challenge or block requests carrying compromised credentials.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Update a custom detection location of a zone.
description: Update a custom detection location of a zone. Update the username and password expressions of an existing detection location, identified by its detection ID. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks/detections/{detection_id}
